extraction.name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
extraction.description: The ARC Dataset consists of a collection of 7787 natural science questions, namely questions authored for use on standardized tests, partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by searching for and investigating available standardized test questions over a period of several months.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: A collection of 7,787 natural science questions from standardized tests, along with a corpus of 14 million science-related sentences.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended to be used as a challenge to evaluate and encourage AI research in advanced question answering, specifically requiring reasoning and commonsense knowledge.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is released and maintained via a dedicated website that includes a leaderboard and allows for the submission of new entries.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set based on the performance of baseline algorithms.

name.evidence: Together, these constitute the AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC), which requires far more powerful knowledge and reasoning than previous challenges such as SQuAD or SNLI.
